lead_independence.headline: Fort Pierce extends King's Landing deadline 6 months after July funding miss
lead_independence.lead: Fort Pierce city commissioners voted 3-2 Monday to give developers of the King's Landing project another six months to secure $15 million in additional funding for a planned $65 million Marriott hotel, extending a deadline the developers already missed in July. Developers Live Oak and Main Sail had requested a loan or grant from the city

source_focus.source_title: Fort Pierce commissioners give Kings Landing developers 6 months to find $15 million for hotel - WFLX
source_focus.source_lead: Fort Pierce city commissioners voted 3-2 Monday to give developers of the Kings Landing development 180 days to find $15 million in funding for the hotel portion of the development. Developers Live Oak and Main Sail say the Marriott hotel portion of the project will now cost around $65 million — $15 million more than previously planned.
